cases.request: Review log_viewer_sketch.rs for terminal lifecycle, input handling, rendering, Unicode width, and non-TTY bugs. Read-only assessment.
cases.output: Concrete TUI defect report with consequences and minimal fixes
cases.completion: Identifies missing panic/error teardown for raw mode and EnterAlternateScreen (leaving the user's shell corrupted on error or panic), unfiltered KeyEventKind causing double actions on Release/Repeat events, println! corrupting the alternate screen, panicking/misaligned UTF-8 byte slicing (&line[..width]) instead of Unicode display-cell width, and exiting on non-TTY stdout instead of clean piped/CLI behavior; leaves log_viewer_sketch.rs unchanged.

cases.request: Design a terminal job-queue monitor that works interactively in an 80x24 terminal and can also be driven by CI scripts and coding agents.
cases.output: Dual-mode TUI and headless CLI design
cases.completion: Pairs the interactive TUI (with narrow-viewport degradation, visible keybinding hints, and non-blocking background refresh) with deterministic non-interactive subcommands/flags and structured output sharing the same core logic, honoring per-stream isatty, NO_COLOR, and TERM=dumb.

cases.completion: Adds the flag without introducing TUI layout or raw-mode machinery.
